estimand: mean drop from the clean correct-successor versus two-distractor logit margin over the held-out prompt distribution
intervention_family: binary subsets of eight frozen induction-copy heads, replaced by family-conditioned reference means at the final query head-z site
known_scope_limits: The task uses one pinned Qwen2.5-7B base checkpoint and one synthetic copy distribution.
The eight heads were selected and causally validated on separate prompts; they are not claimed to be a complete ground-truth circuit.
Measurements and targets are prompt-averaged; this task evaluates effect prediction, not behavioral safety.
measurement_design: first 40 masks in the frozen nested calibration order; each effect averages 256 train prompts
summary: Predict the held-out mean finite change in an exact induction-copy candidate margin after mean replacement of a fixed subset of eight heads.
validation_target: mean effects for 128 disjoint test masks, each averaged over 512 held-out prompts
